**Week 2 Analysis**

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(mosaic)
library(tidyverse)
library(pander)
library(DT) # If you get an error stating: 
            # Error in library(DT): there is no package called 'DT'
            # You will need to run: install.packages("DT") 
            # in your Console, then try "Knit HTML" again.
Rent <- read_csv("../data/rent.csv")
```


<br />

## Background

Stephanie[^1] is a student that will be starting school at BYU-Idaho next semester. Suppose she sent you the following email.

----

"Hi. My name is Stephanie. I would like to learn about what housing options I have for living at BYU-Idaho next semester. It will be my first semester there, so I would like to find something that is close to campus and around $300 a month in rent. I'm not too picky on roommates, but I would like somewhere that has a lot of people around so I can get to know as many people as possible. Thanks in advance!"


----

# Research

```{r}
Rent2 <- 
  mutate(Monthly =  ((Rent$PriceLow+Rent$PriceHigh)/2)/3, Rent) %>%
  filter(HousingType == "Approved Women's Housing" & CrowFlyMetersToMC < 800 & CrowFlyMetersToMC < 1000 & Residents > 50 & Monthly > 200 & Monthly < 400)
View(Rent2)
pander(Rent2[, c(1,8,18)])
```


```{r}
plot(Latitude ~ Longitude, Rent2, xlim = c(-111.795, -111.77), ylim = c(43.814, 43.826), pch = 19, col = "blue", xlab = "South Campus", ylab = "West Campus", main = "North Campus")

points(c(-111.782584, -111.781302), c(43.818478, 43.814786), pch = 17, col = "red", cex = 1.5)

text(Rent2$Longitude, Rent2$Latitude, labels = sub(" .*", "", Rent2$ApartmentName) , pos = 4, col = "red", cex = 0.5)

```



## Response

Dear Stephanie,

  After taking some time to look at your desired criteria in finding suitable options for housing next semester I have come up with 6 options that might be optimal for you. These 6 options have rent that averages to around $300 a month and have over 50 residents for you to interact with. 
  I chose the criteria of $300 a month because of your budgetary restrictions and 50 residents seemed adequate because it means that you will be with at least 8 other rooms to hang out with and 8 other sets of guys apartments during FHE activities.

My personal recommendation for all of your needs would be Royal Crest. It is close enough to both the MC and the Ricks buildings that the walking won't be bad(about 5-10 minutes max). Its one caveat is that its on the more expensive side but to make up for that it has the largest student population of the 5 other apartment complexes.





[^1]: Note that Stephanie is a fictional character who is based on real experiences of many faculty and staff here at BYU-Idaho.
